title: Deeper/broader parser robustness and fuzz-evidence review
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Review current LibreDWG robustness history as an open-source DWG/DXF implementation comparator
Assess the evidence ceiling of peer fuzz and sanitizer findings
Refine the scheduled robustness gate without increasing per-slice validation cost

method.kind: Primary project NEWS, manual, and fuzz-repository review
method.limitations: LibreDWG mutable master is not a pinned release artifact. Peer fuzz/security fixes are not evidence of a matching libdxfrw defect, equivalent coverage, or semantic format support. No external peer was built or run.

sources.observed: The project's recent history describes fuzz-/sanitizer-found bounds, signedness, OOM, out-of-bounds, use-after-free, double-free, and null-dereference issues across DWG/DXF decode, encode, conversion, and JSON paths. This demonstrates active robustness risk in a peer project, not a local defect.

The project documents an AFL++ fuzzing setup; LibreDWG's own manual also documents AFL++/LLVM fuzz frontends and OSS-Fuzz workflows. This informs a scheduled test gate only; it does not establish equivalent local harness coverage.
The manual describes peer-specific critical-error policy, unknown-type handling, and fuzz frontends. Those contracts are not normative for libdxfrw and cannot establish semantic preservation.
The README qualifies DWG writer support by version and known integrity limitations, reinforcing that peer read/write capability claims must be pinned and independently validated.

assessment.planImpact: Adds an implementation-ready, bounded malformed-input robustness checkpoint at the existing scheduled cadence. The fast per-slice target/focused-selector/owning-CTest loop remains unchanged. A no-crash or same-codec round-trip result cannot promote feature, carrier, or solid-semantic support.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep routine slices on the touched target, focused selector, and owning CTest; do not run a full fuzz campaign after every item.
At the scheduled robustness gate, exercise bounded malformed/truncated header, section, page, record, and size-boundary cases under available sanitizers/fuzzers.
Include converter failure cleanup and resource limits; cap input size, runtime, and memory; retain minimized local reproducers only when locally confirmed.
Add a peer-inspired case to the fast suite only after a local regression is reproduced; generate local cases from scratch and do not commit external DWG/DXF fixtures.
Score robustness separately from parser acceptance, unknown data preservation, entity support, carrier association, and ACIS/B-rep semantics.
Treat current LibreDWG master reports as unpinned peer signals; pin exact release/commit/options/output before any comparator run.
